text:
Predicates:
HasFourSides(x) ::: x has four sides.
IsShape(x) ::: x is a shape.
IsSquare(x) ::: x is a square.
Premises:
∀x (IsSquare(x) → HasFourSides(x)) ::: All squares have four sides.
∀x (HasFourSides(x) → IsShape(x)) ::: All four-sided things are shapes.
Conclusion:
∀x (IsSquare(x) → IsShape(x)) ::: All squares are shapes.
